title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #6

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did Siddhartha do for the wounded swan? (1 mark)
   A. He ignored it
   B. He shot it again
   C. He took it away to eat
   D. He pulled out the arrow and nursed it

2. How should you receive prasad? (1 mark)
   A. With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   B. With your left hand only
   C. By snatching
   D. By refusing rudely

3. In the Shibi story, what did the hawk want? (1 mark)
   A. The dove as food
   B. Water
   C. A house
   D. A crown

4. Who should be allowed to board first? (1 mark)
   A. The strongest
   B. The loudest
   C. Children, elders and people with disabilities
   D. The fastest

5. If a classmate is being bullied, which teaching helps? (1 mark)
   A. Join the bullies
   B. Stand up for the child who is troubled
   C. Laugh
   D. Ignore it

6. What is a prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A map
   B. A sport
   C. A kind of meal
   D. A way of talking to God

7. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. Only in
   B. In and out with equal strength
   C. Only out
   D. Not at all

8. What is Ganga jal? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. Water from the River Ganga
   C. A book
   D. A kind of tree

9. Which tree is also called the peepal? (1 mark)
   A. Sal tree
   B. Bodhi tree
   C. Ber tree
   D. Tulsi

10. According to Hindu belief, what does the soul do after death? (1 mark)
   A. Turns into a tree only
   B. Turns to stone
   C. Ends forever
   D. Takes a new body

11. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Ashadha
   B. Magha
   C. Chaitra
   D. Phalguna

12. Where should the hands be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. On the floor in front
   B. In the air
   C. Behind the head
   D. On the thighs

13. Which of these is one of the six directions in the Sigalovada Sutta? (1 mark)
   A. Rivers
   B. Kings
   C. Strangers
   D. Teachers

14. Which principle is about kindness to all living beings? (1 mark)
   A. Prani Daya
   B. Paramatma
   C. Punarjanam
   D. Purushartha

15. What does mata mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Teacher
   C. Friend
   D. Father

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three reasons why prayer is a principle of Dharma. (3 marks)

17. Name any four of the five great elements of the Panch Mahabhoot. (2 marks)

18. Why should we not pollute rivers? (2 marks)

19. Explain why the time and place of the defeat of Hiranyakashipu are special in the story. (3 marks)

20. What is integrity? (2 marks)

21. Match the days to the planets: Budhvaar, Guruvaar, Shukravaar. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   He helped the hurt bird.

2. A — With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   Receive with politeness.

3. A — The dove as food
   The hawk demanded the dove.

4. C — Children, elders and people with disabilities
   We care for those who need help.

5. B — Stand up for the child who is troubled
   Enlightened beings teach kindness and protecting others.

6. D — A way of talking to God
   We thank God and ask for wisdom.

7. B — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

8. B — Water from the River Ganga
   Jal means water, so Ganga jal is water from the Ganga.

9. B — Bodhi tree
   The Bodhi tree is a kind of fig tree, also called the peepal.

10. D — Takes a new body
   This is rebirth.

11. D — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

12. D — On the thighs
   Palms on the thighs.

13. D — Teachers
   Parents, teachers, family, friends, workers and holy teachers.

14. A — Prani Daya
   Prani Daya is compassion.

15. A — Mother
   Mata means mother and pita means father.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It makes us thankful, calm and humble, gives courage, and reminds us we are not alone (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any four of: Prithvi (earth), Jal (water), Agni (fire), Vayu (air), Akash (space).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each correct element, up to 2 marks.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Polluted rivers harm plants, animals and people who use the water, and take away the sacredness of the water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha was neither man nor animal, it was neither day nor night, and it happened at the doorway, neither inside nor outside, so the king's gift did not protect him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three details.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
